title: Inter's papers printed 14 claims this week - only 3 held up
caption:
Inter's press scorecard: the Italian papers printed 14 claims about Inter this week. Three held up, one was wrong, ten are still open.

Gazzetta dello Sport said Ivan Provedel would debut against Shakhtar - Josep Martinez played and made three saves (per Inter.it). Sky Sport Italia named Maurizio Mariani as today's referee two days before the club's own guide did. Carlos Augusto to 2031, per Gazzetta, is still unsigned.
